correctness.rationale: The affine simplex determinant is 1-w^4; its normalized volume is (w^4-1)/(w+1). Every boundary lattice point is a vertex, while all strictly positive integer compositions summing w+1 lie in the interior by explicit positive barycentric coordinates. These facts give exact h*. Explicit positive shifted polynomials prove log-concavity for w≥5 and three disjoint sign-change intervals prove three simple negative roots for w≥7. Four exact cubic discriminants exclude w=3,4,5,6; w=2 is quadratic with nonreal roots. The finite checker independently exhausts 24 small dilations.

value.rationale: A complete natural one-parameter classification of an already motivated non-IDP weighted oriented edge-simplex family: its Ehrhart numerator shows three separate and exact thresholds, with an infinite real-rooted but non-IDP subfamily. The precise small-integer cutoffs distinguish strength of coefficient positivity and supply a transparent geometric counterexample to any expectation that real-rootedness forces IDP.
